text:
maria: FYI Snyk flagged CVE-2025-0813 in tokenizers (native wheel). CI started failing on py39/py310 after yesterday's lock regen. Repro locally with tox on ubuntu.
sec-bot: SNYK: SNYK-PY-2025-0813 - tokenizers <=0.12.0 - unsafe deserialization in Rust extension (high). https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PY-2025-0813
kevin: Confirmed. I bisected — tokenizers 0.12.0 wheel layout change broke our binary ABI used by the keystore client. Fails during import in CI jobs that build wheels.
sam: Proposal: surgical revert tokenizers to 0.11.6 in poetry.lock (no other dependency updates), open hotfix branch, run CI, then backport to release branches. Keep changes minimal to avoid new regressions.
maria: +1. Also we need KMS e2e — keystore uses the native wheel; if tests touch signing we must be careful. @jen can you run KMS integration on the hotfix PR?
jen: On it. I'll run the full matrix on ci-kms and a local run. ETA ~45m. Noting macos py39 had a flaky failure last run.
kevin: Implementation plan:
1) revert tokenizers entry in poetry.lock to 0.11.6 (do not run poetry update)
2) add constraint pin for requirements/pip CI: tokenizers==0.11.6
3) open PR against main, enable CI allowlist for that PR only (to reduce noise)
4) run kms e2e and smoke tests; if green, merge and canary deploy to dedicated infra
5) backport to release/v1.12 and release/v1.11
sam: Commands I used to validate quick fix:
```bash
# pin in constraints.txt for pip-based jobs
printf "tokenizers==0.11.6\n" > ci/constraints/tokenizers.txt
# install with constraints
pip install -c ci/constraints/tokenizers.txt -r requirements.txt
# regenerate poetry.lock entry without changing deps
git checkout -- poetry.lock && python -c "print('manual edit tokenizers entry to previous hash')"
```
maria: Create sec ticket sec-4312 and add CVE details. Also need RBAC approval for deploy because keystore tests touch service-account keys. @ops-approver please review the deploy window if we go forward.
jen: KMS local run: e2e passed for linux/py310 and linux/py39, macos py39 flaky - trying 3 more runs. Will post logs to the PR.
deploy-bot: CI status: PR #1428 — 24 jobs queued/running.
kevin: If CI flakiness persists we can publish an internal wheel mirror with the pinned wheel and point CI at that mirror as fallback. Document in infra-runbook under "wheel-pinning-hotfix".
maria: OK proceed with hotfix PR. I'll open it, assign @sam and @kevin for review. Targeting EOD merge if CI and kms OK.
sam: Once merged i'll cherry-pick to release branches and open backport PRs.
sec-bot: Inventory update: CVE-2025-0813 added, remediation_needed=true, assigned to eng-security.
maria: Thanks all — keep channel updated with PR link and canary results. :thumbsup:
